## Activation

**This module cannot be switched off.** Sight of the write trail. The writing is the platform's own, so this module owns the viewer, and hiding who did what is a governance regression.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
